subject: ela
cluster: Range of reading and level of text complexity
intro: Seventh graders read and comprehend literary nonfiction and informational texts at the grade 6-8 complexity band, independently and proficiently, applying all their skills: central idea, evidence, structure, word meaning, author's purpose, and evaluating arguments.

items.prompt:
Read.

The Industrial Revolution transformed society. Factories drew people from farms to cities, creating both new jobs and crowded, polluted slums.

What is the central idea?

steps: It explains how the Industrial Revolution changed society in good and bad ways.
So the central idea is that the Industrial Revolution transformed society, with benefits and drawbacks.
solution.answer: The Industrial Revolution transformed society, bringing both benefits and drawbacks.

items.prompt:
Read (same passage).

What was one NEGATIVE effect mentioned?

steps: I find the downside in the text.
So one negative effect was crowded, polluted slums.

items.prompt:
Read.

Vaccines work by exposing the body to a harmless piece of a germ, 'training' the immune system to fight the real thing later.

How do vaccines work?

steps: They expose the body to a harmless piece so the immune system learns to fight the germ.
So vaccines train the immune system using a harmless part of a germ.
solution.answer: They train the immune system using a harmless piece of a germ.
